newsitem.title: UK: Lasmo pushed higher in stock shortage.
newsitem.headline: Lasmo pushed higher in stock shortage.

text.p: Shares in Lasmo Plc were squeezed higher in afternoon trading on Wednesday, as a spurt of buying caught the market short of stock, dealers said.
The stock was up 8-1/2p or 3.3 percent at 269-1/2 by 1459 GMT -- the second biggest gainer in the market overall -- in volume of 2.9 million shares.

Market sources said there was talk that NatWest Securities had been hosting a series of meetings between executives from the oil company and fund managers in continental Europe, but added that NatWest had not been actively pushing the stock.
No-one at Lasmo was immediately available for comment.
"There is not much volume, it looks as if a few buyers came in at once and caught the market a bit short," said one sales trader.
